messages.author: 6a41a0249fa37e81
messages.subject: Re: R project accepted
parts:
R has been accepted as a GSOC 2012 organization. However, there was a delay while we put
in our Org. Profile on Melange, and also the (annual!?) fiddle with individual profiles
and logins. Note that Google often releases announcements on Friday afternoon California
time, after much of the rest of the world -- particularly R's world -- is already in
weekend mode.

JN
